# Draft:Next Liberal Democratic Party (Japan) presidential election

The next Liberal Democratic Party presidential election will elect the next president of the Liberal Democratic Party of Japan for a 3-year term. The winner of the election will effectively become the Prime Minister of Japan and will lead the party in the next general election .
It was falsely reported on 23 July 2025 that Shigeru Ishiba, who has served as Prime Minister and LDP President after winning the previous leadership election in September 2024, would resign in late August. The report came after the LDP, and it's coalition partner the Komeito, lost it's majority in the House of Representatives after the October 2024 general election and again in the House of Councilors after the July 2025 Upper House elections.
